Petition Through: Ms. Sunita Bhardwaj, Advocate. versus Union Of India And Others ..... Responde Through: Mr. Gaurav M. Uberhan and Mr. Rahul Dwivedi, Advocates for to 17 and 21. texts.facts: The grievance of the Petitioners as articulated in the present Writ Petition is that the Petitioners' right to livelihood is being affected. It is stated by the learned Counsel for the Petitioners that the Respondent Nos. 15 to 17 and 21 could not close the food and beverages outlet during the Covid- 19 pandemic without the permission of the Central Government.
